project_title: PestOps Pro - Enterprise Pest Control Field Operations Management Platform

context_strategy.primary_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Precision & Industrial Clarity)
context_strategy.target_audience: Field Operations Directors, Dispatchers, Pest Control Technicians (Operators), Branch Managers
context_strategy.emotional_tone: High-reliability tactical command center, field-ready, high contrast, clean & hygienic enterprise operations

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

key_features_design_requirements.login_page: Split screen or glass card layout featuring company logo, demo login preset triggers (Admin, Dispatcher, Field Technician), role badge, and secure authentication form.
key_features_design_requirements.gps_status_bar: Persistent header badge displaying live GPS signal state (Active / Searching / Limited / Denied) with real-time heartbeat status indicator.
key_features_design_requirements.attendance_checkin: Live Web Camera interface with face capture viewport, automatic geofence GPS verification indicator, check-in timestamp, and photo preview before submit.
key_features_design_requirements.service_report_signature: HTML5 Canvas element for customer sign-off with clear/save triggers, offline queue status toggle, and PDF generator trigger.
key_features_design_requirements.live_map_tracking: Leaflet map integration with active technician custom pins, status color codes, route replay animation toggle, and client site geofences.
key_features_design_requirements.reports_export: Date range picker, technician filter, pest type filter, with instant PDF printable preview and Excel CSV generator.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg buttons with high contrast hover effects. Primary action: bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-slate-950 font-bold.
component_guidelines.cards: Subtle border (border-slate-800 or border-slate-200), dark slate background, no harsh drop-shadows, p-5 padding minimum.
component_guidelines.inputs: Must use Shadcn Input, Select, and Checkbox wrapped with clear label typography and explicit hover/focus states.
component_guidelines.toasts: Sonner toast notifications with emerald border for success and red border for emergency dispatch alerts.
component_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, tabs, map pins, and signature controls MUST carry explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='pest-findings-table', data-testid='attendance-checkin-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade Pest Control Field Operations Management Platform with clean architecture and modular React frontend structure.
Implement clear Role-Based Access Control (Admin / Dispatcher / Field Technician) with instant switcher on login page.
Ensure the mobile view offers a dedicated bottom tab navigator for field operators (Today's Tasks, Attendance Camera, Service Report, GPS Route).
Implement pest findings F/M/C/R/A/O grid with interactive severity selector and chemical dosage calculator.
Ensure Leaflet maps and interactive canvas signature run smoothly with error boundary protection.
Ensure all user interactions feature responsive states, sonner notifications, and automated data simulation for real-time tracking.
